attributed_to_the_ic_by_the_directing_te.substance: Installed Vercel 54.14.2 emits a <TOKEN> placeholder in --generate=curl output, not the token; the v1.0.4 justification for refusing it overclaimed.

conveyed_as_remediation_without_explicit.substance: Inherited NODE_OPTIONS, GH_CONFIG_DIR, proxies, provider config-location and credential-related variables were not decided.
Measured scanner gaps: vcp_ token forms, credential URL userinfo, NAME=<value> assignments, classic Vercel token-like forms.
The mutation battery reported SURVIVED as AS_EXPECTED for a mutant expected to be killed, and its aggregate could not fail.
The claim that the write-set supplemental scan returned zero findings was false where fixture literals produce findings.
The high-entropy detector flags ordinary 40+ character mixed-case identifiers such as ruleset/job names.
The DN-0 git fetch was not credential-controlled and its separation from X-R1 was undocumented.
